subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another proven cross-app identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The submitted branch is stale and conflicting, the proposed identity source is disputed by the linked issue and closed sibling PR, and the fix changes message admission behavior where the wrong identity contract can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context and close or replace it only after broader Feishu identity work lands with positive proof.

options.title: Close This Branch And Keep The Issue Canonical
options.body: If union_id remains unavailable, close this stale PR without merging and leave https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40768 as the tracking point for a new approach.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, requested changes on this exact PR, and identified the Feishu identity decision surface as non-mechanical.
